mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO article_favorite (user_id, article_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.status, a.create_time, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM article_favorite f JOIN article a ON a.id = f.article_id AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT article_id FROM article_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_favorite f JOIN article a ON a.id = f.article_id AND a.status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
